notes_for_editor: Thin record: the 1938 build date rests on the Kresek Inventory, which Willhite and the two other sites repeat, so the three sources are not fully independent. No removal date, staffing or fire history is in any source. The FFLOS page names Ray Kresek as nominator (seen in search snippet only); not quoted. Willhite's Burn disk is not stated to be on the lookout footprint, so the story does not place it precisely. Access listed as private because of the 'Private Property, permission needed' line; no source says a closure order exists. Brief's other_names reads 'Stillaguamish/Burn BM'; Willhite's page calls it Burn Lookout, so the BM suffix was not confirmed. No photo URLs captured.
